title: More readers than people
sub: The third and last film of From tables to decisions, in Modern data basics: one definition of casual teaching cost, read where it's defined by every reader, people, Finance's Power BI reports, an app, an agent and a partner outside the university, each as itself, with only what it may see.
howto: The film is drawn in the module's look: the dark navy platform map of The Inner Life of Data, drawn up close. Gold is what people agree on, here the measure; light blue is the platform and the ways data moves; green is what works, red what went wrong, amber a person's turn, and lilac, always with a lock, personal data.
